title: Grain cooperative v. regional freight carrier
result: Settled after mediation, within the range set at intake
summary: A grain cooperative claimed a carrier breached a multi-year hauling contract during harvest.
body: We built a day-by-day timeline from load tickets and dispatch emails, which showed 61 missed pickups (story figures). The case settled at mediation on the second day.

title: Founding member v. manufacturing LLC
result: Defense verdict after a six-day bench trial
summary: A departed founder claimed he was owed a buyout at a valuation the operating agreement did not support.
body: The operating agreement's buy-sell formula controlled. The court entered judgment for our client on all counts.

title: Software reseller v. former sales director
result: Injunction entered by consent; customer list returned
summary: A sales director left for a competitor with a customer export.
body: We obtained a temporary restraining order within four days and the matter resolved by a consent injunction.

title: Appeal of a lease-termination judgment
summary: A commercial landlord appealed a judgment that a lease had been validly terminated.
body: We were brought in after trial. The court of appeals affirmed in a published opinion.

title: General contractor v. school district (delay claim)
result: Award for the contractor on delay costs
summary: A contractor sought delay costs after design changes extended a school renovation by five months.
body: A scheduling expert tied 112 of 150 delay days to owner-directed changes. The panel awarded most of the claimed costs.

title: Family bakery succession and sale
result: Ownership transferred to the next generation and two key employees
summary: A third-generation bakery planned a gradual transfer of ownership.
body: Buy-sell agreement, new operating agreement and estate plans for both founders, closed over eighteen months.

title: Wage claim against a regional clinic group
result: Charge dismissed after a position statement
summary: A former employee filed an agency charge alleging unpaid overtime.
body: Time records and the classification analysis showed exempt status was correct; the agency dismissed the charge.

title: Brand clearance for a cider maker's new line
result: Mark registered; a conflicting name avoided before launch
summary: A cider maker planned a new product line under a name already used by a regional brewer.
body: The clearance search found the conflict before labels were printed. The client launched under a new name that registered without objection.

title: Estate of a retired machinist
result: Estate closed in eleven months with no objections
summary: A personal representative with no legal background administered an estate with a small business and two properties.
body: We used our probate checklist with the representative at every step. The estate closed without a contested hearing.

title: Distribution agreement for a regional cookware maker
result: Five-state distribution agreement signed in six weeks
summary: A cookware maker replaced handshake arrangements with a written distribution agreement before expanding.
body: Exclusive territories, minimum purchase commitments and a termination schedule, with a one-page summary for the sales team.

title: Retail tenant v. shopping center owner
result: Landlord's claim dismissed on summary judgment
summary: A landlord claimed a tenant owed common-area charges outside the lease formula.
body: The lease formula controlled. The court granted summary judgment for our client.
